name: ats-jobs-scraper
title: Job Postings API — Company Career Sites, No Key
description: Live job postings from the public career-site APIs of Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Recruitee, Rippling and Personio. Company slug or careers URL in, one flat schema out with structured salary and postedAt — the date the board says the posting went up. No scraping, no proxies, no API keys.
